author: Zintenka
body:
Hey guys, it's been a century since I last made a map. Especially with the help of other people - thank Zed, Cobby (LeCobalt) and Merp for building the aesthetics :). 



This map is a DTM, it's currently not finished as I need to do the regions and flip the islands. But expect it to be done soon :)

Authors:
  • Zintenka
  • Zedther
  • LeCobalt
  • Awesomerp






Sword Commando: The backbone of the team, comes with extra shielding to add a little something against oncoming damage as weak as a powerful melee weapon. 

- Sharp 1 stone sword
- absorption 2

Bow Commando: The guy who's ready to take your head off from miles away. Watch out for him... His shots will pierce your limb... When in his sight... It is quite a fright... 

Get ready for a fight...

- power 1 and infinity bow
- night vision

Defender Commando: The one who hangs back and makes sure that everything is good in the objective. The one who sacrifices the most out of everyone in order to keep the sacred monument safe... as such, he is compensated quite nicely.

No one pays much attention to him... with this he does shady dealings with vampires.

- night vision
- damage resistance 2
- infinity bow
- TNT
- Iron spade with wither 2

Rusher Commando: The guy who's feeble and weak yet knows how to keep on his toes. If you don't watch him closely you'll find yourself unexpectedly falling over a ledge, getting combo'd or getting your monument mined.

His sword is poison.

- speed 1
- night vision
- weakness 3
- stone sword with poison 1

Download
YML
Imgur 

Hope you guys will enjoy the map :)

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Yeah, they'll have helmets but not the ones that you think ;)

Let's just say that Rushers like obsidian a lot.

Yeah, there's a spawner at the front of each side that has a fallingsand entity spawner that makes diamonds drop.

There are more secrets to the map... especially one that you may find to your dismay >:)

EDIT: You shouldve seen the defenders before... I made them have the iron spade because it will only do 3+ attack damage. They're not gonna be allowed to leave the island except for when they want to change their kit.

I have to make it worthwhile to be a defender otherwise there wont be much defending.. THey have high defense but weak attack with slight vampirism (Wither 2). It will make people play smartly and not push over the guys holding iron shovels in their hands.
